description: Source code for a video screencast encoder using libvpx, integrated with Mozilla's threading and WebM writing infrastructure. Implements frame conversion, encoding, and file output for screencast data.

classes.name: ScreencastEncoder::VPXFrame
classes.description: Represents a video frame to be encoded, with conversion to vpx_image_t format and cropping/scaling capabilities.

classes.name: ScreencastEncoder::VPXCodec
classes.description: Handles encoding of frames using libvpx, manages encoding thread, and writes WebM output.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Creates and initializes a vpx_image_t with specified width and height, allocating aligned buffer.

methods.name: encodeFrameAsync
methods.description: Encodes a frame asynchronously on a dedicated thread, handling frame repetition for long durations.

methods.name: finishAsync
methods.description: Finalizes encoding asynchronously and executes callback upon completion.
